# Public regression fixtures

These fixtures preserve independent source data for the five adapted public
examples. They do not depend on another resource server being installed and were
not generated by running `swe_external1`.

Source: [Gym PR #3327](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/3327), pinned to
commit `5b02366a3039fbf0d0d3d8e0b2099bf213b97c9d`.

- `source-examples.json` projects the source
  [`example.jsonl`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/5b02366a3039fbf0d0d3d8e0b2099bf213b97c9d/resources_servers/swe_rebench/data/example.jsonl)
  onto the fields used by the integrity assertions: task ID, prompt, image,
  repository, base commit, solution/test patches, installation configuration,
  and required test lists. Field values are unchanged; only the JSON container
  and formatting differ. Source-file SHA-256:
  `8edb23b75492ef21b14e70de481d748e0bbcc6741314b302a89083454647a687`.
- `recorded-test-outputs.json` maps each source instance ID to its unchanged
  `test_output` from
  [`example_rollouts.jsonl`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/blob/5b02366a3039fbf0d0d3d8e0b2099bf213b97c9d/resources_servers/swe_rebench/data/example_rollouts.jsonl).
  Agent trajectories and unrelated rollout metadata are not copied. The
  `intel__rohd-458` log retains the source's 100,000-character truncation; the
  parser must still reject missing required tests. Source-file SHA-256:
  `d4ebd874a4f18ca0f727a2698f184b0742bb26314b862cff777e08aed2f88fec`.

The public task dataset is [nebius/SWE-rebench-V2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nebius/SWE-rebench-V2),
licensed [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the source
repositories retain their respective licenses. The source adapter is part of
Apache-2.0-licensed NeMo Gym. The MIT-licensed SWE-rebench parser and its original
license are embedded in `../../data/example.jsonl`; see the server README and
root `ATTRIBUTIONS.md` for parser provenance.

These logs are offline parser-regression inputs, not golden or model rollout
evidence for this server. They do not replace the pending live validation or
the legacy `data/example_rollouts.jsonl` artifact.
